data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5fd0dd10c64cb6b66ffbd74858bad10915b0ca01
* **Context Scope:** CI workflow `review-sub-pr`; PR #658; cycle 2 re-review

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

When the Reviews API fallback fires (findings re-routed to issue comments), the cycle≥2 defense mechanism (`DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE` + `GitHubPRDefenseStore` / `review-github-defense-store.sh`) must still be able to associate prior resolutions with re-emitted findings. Cycle 2 should consume existing defenses and suppress already-resolved findings regardless of which GitHub comment surface (PR review thread vs. issue comment) they landed on.

#### Actual Behavior

2026-06-05, PR #658: `review-sub-pr` CI job emitted `WARNING: Reviews API failed (CalledProcessError); re-routing anchored findings to issue comments` (see `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py:1525-1526`). All 3 findings landed as issue comments instead of PR review threads. The `GitHubPRDefenseStore` / `review-github-defense-store.sh` defense-record mechanism could not locate the original findings on the PR review thread surface, so resolutions from remediation commit `5fd0dd10c6` were not associated. Cycle 2 re-emitted all 3 findings verbatim — deterministic re-block. Resolution required `/dso:fp-recovery` (opus manual review: 0 findings) followed by human web-UI merge.

**Speculative (marked per Zero Inference Rule — not confirmed):** The suspected 422 cause is that one or more findings were anchored to source lines not in the PR diff (finding 1 cited an unmodified line); the Reviews API rejects unanchorable positions with HTTP 422. This is NOT confirmed root cause — it is a hypothesis for investigation.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Cycle 1: `review-sub-pr` ran; Reviews API returned 422; findings fell back to issue comments
  * Remediation commit `5fd0dd10c6` applied
  * Cycle 2: re-emitted all 3 findings verbatim (defenses not consumed)
  * `/dso:fp-recovery` invoked; opus manual review: 0 findings
  * Human web-UI merge
* **Known Workarounds:** `/dso:fp-recovery` + human web-UI merge (inefficient; bypasses the autonomous review convergence loop)

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* **Active Workflow:** CI `review-sub-pr` → `dso_ci_review` cycle dispatcher
* **Skills Invoked:** `review-github-defense-store.sh`, `GitHubPRDefenseStore`, cycle-2 re-review

### 7. Additional Details

Fallback code location: `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py:1525-1526` — the `except (CalledProcessError, TimeoutExpired, FileNotFoundError)` block extends `unanchored` with all anchored findings and routes them to `gh pr comment` (issue comment surface) instead of the PR review thread surface.

Fix direction: the defense store lookup in `review-github-defense-store.sh` / `GitHubPRDefenseStore` must either (a) search both PR review thread comments and issue comments for defense records, or (b) the fallback path must write findings to the defense store under a surface-agnostic key so cycle-2 lookup succeeds regardless of where the finding landed.
data.title: dso_ci_review/runner.py: Reviews API 422 -> defense loop broken; cycle-2 re-emits all findings verbatim
